## What changed and why

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and platforms tested. Include screenshots for UI changes,
with account details and conversation content removed.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, pairing links, local profiles, or private conversation data are included.
- [ ] I used my own accounts or isolated fixtures for testing.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests and relevant documentation updates.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `npm run notices:check` pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Platform-specific changes preserve existing macOS behavior.
- [ ] I contribute this work under the project's MIT license.
